window.sma_selection: all eight pairs or any one existing pair, separately by side
window.eligibility: At least 20 validation trades, 5 symbols and 3 active days, positive net P&L in all three seed replays, positive on at least two-thirds of observed validation days, positive 0.0055556 quantile of resampled daily net P&L. Reject unpriced and missing-funding outcomes. Rank by lower bound, then smaller closed-trade drawdown. Consider cash.
window.training: Train three full entry networks per feature configuration on the original price-error episodes, fixed 4000 Adam updates. Reference is the frozen no-indicator ensemble. Exit ensembles and 0.5 exit score stay fixed.
window.funding: Historical Hyperliquid hourly rates applied to position quantity times the settlement-minute open, a proxy for settlement mark. Charge funding if entry < settlement <= exit.
window.test_status: Post-selection dates previously unused in this four-model optimization. Event-time replay with historical/recovered prices.
